newsitem.title: UK: London Clubs bid for Capital lapses.
newsitem.headline: London Clubs bid for Capital lapses.

text.p: London Clubs International Plc said on Monday that its current offer for gaming firm Capital Corp Plc has lapsed, and that the board will be meeting to "consider appropriate future action".
It made the statement in response to the UK's decision earlier today to refer the proposed acquisition to the monopolies and mergers commission (MMC).

"Naturally, we are disappointed by the recommendation of the director general of fair trading. We believe that the arguments which we submitted to the OFT provided sound evidence that there were no adverse competition issues," said Alan Goodenough, chief executive of London Clubs.
London Clubs launched a hostile bid for Capital Corp on February 17.
Capital Corp said in a seprate statement that the referral enables it to focus on developing the group's business, "without the distraction and expense of a hostile bid".
